response.justification: This candidate is a full-stack and web/mobile software developer with no demonstrated background in SoC/IP modeling, hardware-software co-design, GPU/SIMD architecture, or deep-learning workload performance optimization. The resume shows strong general software engineering breadth (web, embedded tooling, DevOps) but nothing aligned with the Principal Performance Architect role's core focus on AI accelerator hardware and cloud infrastructure performance.
strengths: Extensive and varied senior/staff-level software engineering experience
Demonstrated low-latency/high-performance systems work at Dunnhumby (DLang, async I/O, fibers)
Strong open-source contributions and technical leadership (talks, workshops, founder role)
concerns: No evidence of SoC/IP modeling or system architecture design experience
No GPU, SIMD/MIMD, or deep-learning workload optimization background
Career trajectory is generalist full-stack/web development, not hardware or performance architecture

key_factors.factor: No deep-learning or GPU workload optimization background
Strong general senior software engineering track record
